title: ClaimAccount
description: device -> server, sent on an established (challenge-verified) connection to claim this device for a signed-in account (design doc D-33). The connection itself proves possession of the device's Keystore key, the same pattern regenerate_secret uses, so the message carries no device identifier of its own. account_token is a short-lived, single-use token the app's own backend-facing session mints right after Google sign-in completes (POST /v1/accounts/claim-token) — not the OAuth access token itself, so a leaked claim token can't be replayed for anything beyond the one claim it was minted for.
